blockingFindings.title: Registry documents required string arrays but validator accepts optional entry objects
blockingFindings.issue: The command help now advertises `{modules: string[], data_flow: string[], decisions: string[]}` and says all three categories are required, but `validateOverviewAdditions()` delegates to `validateAdditions(additions)`, which this diff does not show being changed from the existing overview merge contract of optional category arrays containing `{text}` entries. That creates a user-visible contract mismatch for `flow run update-overview --json`: valid documented input can be rejected, while older optional object-entry input can still be accepted.
blockingFindings.suggestion: Update `validateAdditions()`/`validateOverviewAdditions()` to enforce the registry contract exactly, or change the registry help text back to the actual accepted shape. Add tests for missing categories and string-array entries so R2 stays pinned to the intended contract.
blockingFindings.rationale: Rejected by impl-triage after direct source verification: src/flow/lib/overview-merge.js:21-60 already enforces the exact required keys, string arrays, and configured bounds, so the claimed R2 contradiction does not exist and no repair is warranted.
